newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's listed firms propose low dividend tax.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's listed firms propose low dividend tax.

text.p: The Korea Listed Companies Association said on Thursday it has proposed to the finance ministry that tax on dividends be cut by 50 percent as part of a programme to boost stock investment.
"Low dividend income due to high taxes has been detrimental to the sound development of the stock market," said an association official.

He said the separate withholding tax rate applied to dividends should be lowered to 10 percent from the current 15 percent. It also proposed that double taxation on dividend income be abolished. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5645
